props.gloss_en: the mishna: [one who] has no testicles, or only one -- this is the meroach ashekh stated in the Torah
R' Yishmael: anyone whose testicles were crushed (restated at 44b.15 as שנמרחו אשכיו)
R' Akiva: anyone who has wind in his testicles
R' Chanina ben Antigonus: anyone whose appearance is dark
difficult for R' Yishmael: [on the mishna's reading] the verse should have said 'chasar ashekh' (lacking a testicle)
difficult for R' Akiva: [on R' Yishmael's reading] the verse should have said 'mimroach ashekh'
difficult for R' Chanina ben Antigonus: [on R' Akiva's reading] the verse should have said 'ruach ashekh'
he holds: one subtracts and adds [letters] and expounds
R' Chanina ben Antigonus does not teach 'kushi'
